title: Orbit and Archive
author: Tamsin Fairweather
blurb: Emrys Okafor, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
